answer: An agent registers by locking a locked liquidity-pool share as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. Detection runs on analysis of reciprocity in the attestation graph: any agent caught running a ring that attests only to itself is flagged. Conviction means the challenger who proved the fault keeps the slashed funds. The ledger keeps every bond inside an ivory the owner cannot hide. The fable stake is checked each epoch; a sold identity loses standing. Each fake needs its own bridge, and each bridge costs a full bond.
